items.q: These are different shows that they put on that we were in with them where we had Connie Boswell, Jack Haley. We had George Jessel

ctx.x: That's where I actually go from Riverside, leaving Frank Sinatra and go back to -- let's see, where do we go from there. 1920, 1921 -- I've forgotten what year that was, 1921. I'm going to California now on the Pantages circuit. I left the Pantages circuit -- was that then -- I can take that later -- I can take Paul Small next and Finkelhoff, they were agents for a show called "Curtain Time," "Laugh Time" and "Show

Time." These are different shows that they put on that we were in with them where we had Connie Boswell, Jack Haley. We had George Jessel and this colored act called Miller Brothers and Lois, that's a dance act --
